integrity: The proof is exact and non-computational. The focal source formulas were checked directly, and the only external ingredient is the classical reproducing-kernel/Paley--Wiener description of the one-variable upper-half-plane Hardy space plus standard Hilbert tensor-product density.
scientific_limitations: The theorem identifies only the closed span generated by the representing vectors in the pure-linear one-coordinate model. It does not prove that the self-adjoint relations reduce to this Hardy subspace, does not classify minimal relation realizations, and does not address coupled models with several nonzero linear coefficients or nonzero Nevanlinna measure.
title: Hardy-tensor cyclic core of the pure linear several-variable Herglotz representation
